title: Watching Sports

sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: a single or multi-message switch record a sports phrase e.g. "GO [TEAM NAME]!"
sections.middleText2: a sports match - go to the match or watch live

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. The switch user cheers for their team while watching the match with friends/family.
2. Change the recorded phrase to the team chant/song to celebrate if you win!

tooltipText: Use a switch for WATCHING SPORTS
